issue.title: Migrate legacy prompt Markdown out of the SASE plans store
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-t.4.4. Reproduce with 'sase plan links validate --show-warnings': 57 files under 202607/prompts and 202608/prompts fail with prompt-in-plans-store because legacy prompt Markdown remains in the plans store. Migrate those prompts to the canonical agents-sidecar archive while preserving durable references, then rerun link validation and confirm all 57 errors are gone. The separate parent-unpublished warning for 202608/bob_cli_n_landing.md is transient and out of scope.

payload.description: Both concern hygiene of the bob-cli--plans SDD store; bob-cli-y migrates legacy prompt Markdown out of it, this one is about plans that never reach it.
